class.description: GeometryCSGBridgeControl (Tier 3/4 Cross-Plugin Geometry Workbench) Provides interactive CSG clipping, Wave-2 boundary classification, seam welding, and 1-click bridging between `Polygon2DResource`, `VoronoiDiagram2DResource`, and `SDFGrid2DResource`. Part of IdeamGeometry (2D/3D polygons, Voronoi diagrams, SDF grids, and tensor fields).
